purpose: Individually placed sepia engineering studies for randomized per-level backgrounds

assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG illustration for the background of a Renaissance inventor's marble puzzle.
Primary request: an original Leonardo da Vinci-style engineering notebook study, rendered as convincing fine sepia quill pen ink with delicate uneven contour strokes, dense cross-hatching, accurate three-dimensional perspective, observed materials and small exploratory construction lines. Not a clean vector drawing or a modern 3D render.
Subject: a Renaissance aerial screw flying machine. A broad spiral sail of thin linen, visible radial wooden ribs and convincing layered helical geometry around a central shaft, standing on a round timber platform with simple cranks, braces and rope lashings. Show the underside and overlapping folds clearly in three-quarter perspective. Subtle pen hatching describes linen tension and wood grain, delicate exploratory arcs describe rotation.
Composition: a single coherent study centered on a square canvas, fully visible with generous transparent margin on all sides, no other detached studies. Ink has light and dark warm walnut-brown lines with open transparent space between strokes. No paper, no beige rectangle, no background, no exterior shadow, true alpha transparency. No lettering, no labels, no numbers, no signature or watermark. These are original imagined studies, not a copy of a particular historical notebook page.
